description.zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
description.en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or an STS token for authentication.

description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: Specifies the organization ID. You can obtain this ID from your Alibaba Cloud DevOps URL. For example: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.
The unique identifier for the repository.

description.zh: 分支名称、标签名称或Commit ID
description.en: A commit reference, such as a branch name, tag name, or commit ID.
Specifies whether to show the signature. The default value is false.
